name: Harem Tender
description: You served as caretaker, coordinator, or favored intimate within a harem, managing pleasure and harmony among multiple partners.

traits: I read a room's desires before anyone speaks.
Jealousy is a poison I neutralize with a smile and a touch.
I take quiet pride in making everyone feel like the favorite.
Harmony among lovers is the most beautiful music.
I remember every preference of every lover I've tended.
I am discreet to a fault – secrets die with me.
I orchestrate pleasure the way a conductor leads an orchestra.
I find deep satisfaction in service, even when unseen.

ideals.text: Harmony. Many hearts can beat as one with the right guidance.
Pleasure. Everyone deserves to feel desired and satisfied.
Order. A well-run harem is a masterpiece of civilization.
Devotion. True loyalty is shown through care for all, not just one.
Excess. Why choose one when many can share bliss?
Power. Controlling desire is the ultimate control.

bonds: The sovereign I once served still holds my heart – or my contract.
I swore to protect the other members of my former harem with my life.
A rival tender seeks to ruin my reputation out of jealousy.
I search for the one lover who saw me as more than a servant.
My current patron demands absolute exclusivity – a vow I struggle to keep.
I owe a life-debt to the harem that raised and trained me.
flaws: I become anxious when attention is focused on only one person.
I manipulate emotions without realizing it, even among friends.
I judge monogamous relationships as inefficient or selfish.
Old jealousies from the harem still haunt my dreams.
I keep score of favors and pleasures owed.
I struggle to form deep bonds with only one partner.
